thread:
marta (CS): quick sync — orbiton private deploy day0. main open items: CMK import for KMS, cross-account IAM role binding, audit log forwarding to their SIEM, and a couple of VPC route/table questions. can we triage?
ryan (SRE): i pulled their infra terraform earlier, looks like they chose shared-nat instead of per-az nat. might affect egress IP sticky mapping for audit endpoints.
alex (Solutions): for CMK import: we need the wrapped key blob + import token from their HSM. noah, do you have the artifact from your security team?
noah (Orbiton): wrapping key is here, sending to the AE email. forgot to include the import token in the first package — on it now.
claudia (AE): fyi customer mentioned audit retention compliance depends on logs reaching Splunk within 30 minutes — flagged as a renewal risk if not validated by EOW.
marta (CS): noted. can we set a P0 checklist: 1) KMS import validated, 2) IAM assume-role tested from priv account, 3) audit logs delivered to splunk index 'orbiton-prod', 4) egress IPs confirmed.
ryan (SRE): will run the assume-role test once CMK is active. quick IAM snippet i plan to use:  ```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-infer-priv"},"Action":"sts:AssumeRole"}]
}
```
alex (Solutions): for audit ingestion we recommend a small buffering lambda + Kinesis Firehose to handle retries — avoids >30m gaps during bursty traffic. can demo config in 15m.
marta (CS): that would help the renewal ask. can you drop the demo link and a short runbook snippet here after the call?
deploy-bot: ticket CS-4721 created and assigned to ryan, alex. https://tickets.internal/CS-4721 (automated)
noah (Orbiton): import token uploaded to the shared S3 bucket now: s3://orbiton-sec/keys/import-token.bin (permissions: orbiton/sec-team + redwood-priv-role).
ryan (SRE): starting CMK import verify: running import command locally and calling KMS DescribeKey after. will paste logs if anything fails.
marta (CS): also captures: customer onboarding health = yellow because of the audit SLA risk and CMK delay. Claudia, want me to escalate to AE weekly executive update?
claudia (AE): yes please, escalate but mark as mitigated if alex's buffer pattern is accepted by Orbiton security. include timeline: demo today, validation by tomorrow EOD.
alex (Solutions): demo link: https://meet.redwood/demo/soln-4721. runbook snippet for firehose:  - create delivery stream -> set S3 backup + encryption using imported CMK -> transform lambda retry 3x -> destination Splunk HEC.
noah (Orbiton): Splunk ops confirmed they can accept HEC and will whitelist our egress IPs once we give final IPs.
ryan (SRE): CMK import completed, KeyState: ENABLED. testing assume-role -> success. logs: "sts:AssumeRole succeeded for arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-infer-priv"
marta (CS): great progress — changing health to green contingent on Splunk ingestion test. alex, can you kick the firehose test?
alex (Solutions): kicking test now. sending 1000 simulated events -> monitoring delivery latency.
(no longer than 5m) deploy-bot: smoke run completed, 1000 events delivered, median latency 18s, worst 112s. link: https://telemetry.redwood/runs/4721
noah (Orbiton): saw events in Splunk index orbiton-prod. retention tags look correct. thanks team! :party_parrot:
marta (CS): awesome — i'll update the onboarding tracker and include this thread in the week0 handoff notes. closing action items: CMK import ✅, IAM assume-role ✅, audit ingestion ✅, egress IP finalization pending (noah to confirm when whitelisting is done).
claudia (AE): i'll note risk cleared for renewal cadence. thanks all. :thumbsup:
